description: Third-party recognition earned by Combine companies. Merge Combinator does not select, sponsor, or judge these awards and claims no credit for them.
publishingStandard: A record only belongs here if the granting body evaluates on measured performance, expert panel, or peer review; publishes its methodology; and does not charge to enter or to win. Commercial award programs that solicit nominations across a wide category lattice are marketing assets, not evidence — see docs/plans/2026-08-21-cohort-recognition-promoter.md. Enforced by scripts/promote-recognition.mjs.
